decimal_conversion: Decimal(str(Parquet value)); price complement computed as Decimal(1) - price; no epsilon tolerance.
method: Decimal aggregation by (tx_hash, condition_id), with acceptance at the measured 4-decimal source quantum; fill values are not rounded or changed.

per_tx_condition_conservation.method: Group taker-order rows against maker rows by (tx_hash, condition_id), sum size_shares using Decimal(str(value)), then compare at the 4-decimal source quantum.

source_precision_evidence.source_precision_claim: The source lake serializes size_shares at four decimal places; on-chain amounts have six decimal places.

tolerance.justification: All 43 non-zero residuals are exactly one 4-decimal source quantum. The source lake stores size_shares to four decimal places while on-chain amounts have six decimal places, so each summed maker row may contribute at most one source quantum of rounding. Fill values remain unchanged.

price_indexed_diagnostic.interpretation: Descriptive only: a taker order's price/size can aggregate multiple maker order price levels, so price-indexed buckets are not the transaction-condition conservation gate.
